paint.current_subfamily_scope: Human CHST3 and the listed mouse, rat, chicken and ray orthologs are SF60. The five human GlcNAc-activity source proteins are SF3/4/5/13/40. Current membership does not reconstruct historical IBD placement or establish target-specific loss.
